p4c1.caption: Plate 1 · The sealed eye
p4c1.content_rationale: The Book III title-tablet: one spaced-capitals paragraph that is architecture, not prose ('P R I N C I P L E O F A N E W D E T E R M I N AT I O N O F VA L U E S'). The plate keeps the eye whole and sealed — guarded, unopened — with a single diagonal gouge across it: the new determination has been announced but not yet enacted. No inscription, no drop cap, no apparatus: the monument stands alone.
p4c1.opener_composition: TABLET (W5): centered monument — plate-mark above, mono eyebrow, huge spaced Fraunces 900 title-text as the single paragraph, no drop cap, no fragment inscription. Reads intentional, not empty.
p4c1.palette_role: Verdigris sealed eye @.85; one Sulphur pupil point (match logic) as the only heat; prose Bone centered monument.
p4c1.title: Principle of a New Determination of Values

p4c10.caption: Plate 10 · The withheld pupil
p4c10.content_rationale: The chapter that refuses the knower his prize: the sore spot in Kantian criticism (para 0), unity as organization (para 12), the world-of-truth collapse (para 26), the numbered (2)/(3)/(4) close (paras 36-38). The plate tears the pupil out entirely — the wound as exhibit (designer's Parrhasius principle) — Sulphur hatch radiating around the empty socket, veil-folds at the rim.

fleurons.opening_words: It is perfectly idle to suppose that things have a nature in themselves
fleurons.rationale: Unity-as-organization movement: the dismissal of natures-in-themselves opens the collective-action account of unity (para 13).

fleurons.opening_words: The ‘world of truth’, in whatever form it has thus far been conceived
fleurons.rationale: World-of-truth collapse: the verdict that the true world was illusion all over again, before the illusoriness-as-activity turn (para 27).
Numbered close: the (2)/(3)/(4) sequence ends; the war-of-subjects coda (paras 39-40) follows unornamented.

p4c10.nb_note: start-anchored NB at para 18 ('NB. The explanation of an event may be sought first...') — Souffléd margin cry, Sulphur bar + mono marker

p4c10.palette_role: Verdigris eye + empty socket; Sulphur hatch ring rationed to the wound; NB bar Sulphur; sub-notes Verdigris ticks; fleurons Sulphur.
p4c10.title: Thing-in-itself and Appearance

p4c11.caption: Plate 11 · Vapor and the ghost
p4c11.content_rationale: The 121-fragment giant on metaphysical need: being as living (para 46), the contradiction-scheme (para 59), the greatest error (para 60), nihilism-overcoming (para 90). The plate dissolves the eye into rising vapor-wisp cuts — the rarefied valued over the real — the pupil a faint Sulphur ghost low in frame. The relief band after para 60 marks the error-hinge at chapter scale.

fleurons.opening_words: That is the greatest error ever committed
fleurons.rationale: Greatest-error hinge: the verdict on reason's criterion of reality; band site AND fleuron — the band carries the visual weight.

fleurons.opening_words: Overcoming the philosophers by annihilating the world of being
fleurons.rationale: Nihilism-overcoming turn: the intermediate period of nihilism announced before the strength/weakness symptomology (para 91).

p4c11.nb_note: no start-anchored NB; mid-line NB at paras 55, 107 — awareness only, no v1 hook (never text-guess in CSS)

p4c11.palette_role: Verdigris dissolving eye + wisps; faint Sulphur ghost pupil (most withdrawn accent in cohort after p4c7); 16 sub-notes Verdigris ticks; relief band Verdigris + one Sulphur pupil.

p4c11.title: Metaphysical Need

p4c12.caption: Plate 12 · One nick on the rim
p4c12.content_rationale: The short unbroken arc (11 fragments): certainty evaded only to return through values — 'the question of values is more fundamental than the question of certainty' (para 1). The plate keeps the eye nearly whole with ONE Sulphur scale-weight nick on the rim (values read into things) and a faint backgrounded second pupil, subordinated not annihilated. No fleurons: the arc must not be cut.
p4c12.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated nicked plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '11 FRAGMENTS · 387 WORDS', Fraunces 900 Bone drop cap.
p4c12.palette_role: Verdigris near-whole eye; single Sulphur nick (sparsest accent in cohort); prose calm, no apparatus.
p4c12.title: Biological Value of Knowledge

p4c13.caption: Plate 13 · The prism-slit
p4c13.content_rationale: The cohort finale: science as interpretation not explanation (para 16), humanizing the world (para 34), idealism-into-nihilism and the new arts (paras 48-49), closing on the NB cry 'Zarathustra constantly parodies all previous values, out of abundance' (para 51). The plate: one Bone beam enters the eye's edge, fans into Verdigris spectrum-cuts, exits through a Sulphur slit — the eye become an instrument that knows it invents; the pupil a small fierce Sulphur point (tragic pride).

fleurons.rationale: Interpretation-not-explanation hinge: 'there are no facts' lands before the true/untrue distinction work (para 17).

fleurons.opening_words: To ‘humanize’ the world, i.e. to feel our increasing mastery over it
fleurons.rationale: Humanize-the-world hinge: mastery stated before knowledge's new forms for superior beings (para 35).

fleurons.opening_words: All of mankind’s previous idealism is about to turn into nihilism
fleurons.rationale: Annihilation→new-arts close: the worthlessness verdict before the amphibian arts (para 49); the NB closer (para 51) ends the chapter bare.

p4c13.palette_role: Verdigris fan + Bone beam; Sulphur slit + fierce pupil point (finale heat); NB bar Sulphur; fleurons Sulphur.
p4c13.title: Science

p4c2.caption: Plate 2 · The method mount
p4c2.content_rationale: The 8-fragment method overture: the triumph of scientific method over science (para 0), the most valuable insights are the methods (para 3), contempt for contemporary presuppositions (para 4), the pathos of mankind against us (para 5). The plate mounts the eye as a caliper/microscope instrument under a crosshair pupil — method as apparatus. Minimal Sulphur: a short chapter gets a short flame.

fleurons.opening_words: All the methods, all the presuppositions on which contemporary science rests
fleurons.rationale: Methods→pathos turn: contempt for current presuppositions stated, before the pathos-of-mankind passage (para 5).

p4c2.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated caliper plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '8 FRAGMENTS · 277 WORDS', Fraunces 900 Bone drop cap.
p4c2.palette_role: Verdigris instrument eye; Sulphur crosshair ticks only (minimal accent); single fleuron Sulphur.
p4c2.title: The Will to Power as Knowledge — Method of Enquiry

p4c3.caption: Plate 3 · The inward pit
p4c3.content_rationale: The inward turn: psychology and epistemology (para 8: 'even the inner world is phenomenal'), causality eluding us (para 9). The plate gouges the pupil into a pit that reflects the eye smaller inside — the observer observing observation — ringed by a dashed uncertainty ring. No fleuron at split-fragment seams (paras 5/6, 13/14 stay uncut).

fleurons.rationale: Inner-world phenomenalism hinge: the phenomenal-inner verdict lands, before the causality-eludes-us turn (para 9).

p4c3.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated inward-pit plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '19 FRAGMENTS · 1,721 WORDS', Fraunces 900 Bone drop cap.
p4c3.palette_role: Verdigris eye + dashed uncertainty ring; tiny Sulphur point in the reflected eye; single fleuron Sulphur.
p4c3.title: The Epistemological Starting Point

p4c4.caption: Plate 4 · Seven cuts for seven needs
p4c4.content_rationale: The ego demolition: against positivism (para 0), needs interpreting the world — 'every impulse is an ambition' (para 2), the word 'I' as ignorance-marker (para 3). The plate drives SEVEN radial sight-cuts through the rim (needs/impulses-as-observers, staggered ring radii per prototype finding), explodes the pupil ring, and keeps a Sulphur core. No fleuron at the split fragment (paras 4/5 stay uncut).

fleurons.opening_words: It is our needs which interpret the world
fleurons.rationale: Needs-interpret turn: the impulse-as-observer thesis lands, before the 'I'-as-ignorance passage (para 3).

p4c4.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated seven-cut plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '32 FRAGMENTS · 1,674 WORDS', Fraunces 900 Bone drop cap.
p4c4.palette_role: Verdigris eye under seven gouge cuts; Sulphur core (hottest pupil in cohort); single fleuron Sulphur.
p4c4.title: The Belief in the ‘Ego’. The Subject.

p4c5.caption: Plate 5 · The need-ward cell
p4c5.content_rationale: Truth as life-serving error (para 0), thinking as enforced configuration (para 7), perceptions projected outer/inner (para 8), and the NB margin cry on a priori truths as provisional assumptions (para 5). The plate renders the eye as a CELL: doubled membrane walls, the nucleus-pupil offset toward the rim (need-ward — interest-driven perception), feeder rootlets below.

fleurons.rationale: Outer/inner projection hinge: configuration-thinking stated, before the projection question (para 8).

p4c5.nb_note: start-anchored NB at para 5 ('NB. I regard the best-believed a priori ‘truths’...') — Sulphur bar + mono marker
p4c5.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated cell plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '24 FRAGMENTS · 1,221 WORDS'. First para is quote-led so shared .no-drop applies — cohort extends, never fights it.
p4c5.palette_role: Verdigris cell membranes + offset nucleus; Sulphur nucleus point; NB bar Sulphur; fleuron Sulphur.
p4c5.title: Biology of the Instinct for Knowledge. Perspectivism.

p4c6.caption: Plate 6 · Chaos learning the grid
p4c6.content_rationale: Logic born of chaos: origin out of an original chaos of ideas (para 0), the (1)/(2) sub-note sequence on imprecise organs and equating intellect (paras 5-6), categories proved by utility (para 12), schematizing chaos as the object (para 13). The plate dissolves the left half into stipple-static and rules the right half into a hatch lattice, one Sulphur thread equating a dot into the grid. No fleuron at the split seam (paras 8/9 stay uncut).

fleurons.opening_words: Exactly the same thing might have happened with the categories of reason
fleurons.rationale: Categories→schematize turn: utility-proved categories stated, before the will-to-power-as-schematizing thesis (para 13).

p4c6.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated chaos-lattice plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '40 FRAGMENTS · 2,590 WORDS'. First para is short so shared .no-drop applies — cohort extends, never fights it.
p4c6.palette_role: Verdigris chaos + lattice halves; Sulphur assimilation thread; sub-notes Verdigris ticks; fleuron Sulphur.
p4c6.title: The Origin of Reason and Logic

p4c7.caption: Plate 7 · A meniscus of light
p4c7.content_rationale: Consciousness demoted: mental/physical faces (para 0), the nervous system vaster than consciousness — 'consciousness is ancillary' (para 8), physiologists on lucidity (para 9), the NB on precision vs forethought (para 10). The plate gouges the eye 90% dark — only a thin Sulphur meniscus of surface light survives, with a deaf lip-reading slit. The most withdrawn plate in the cohort.

fleurons.opening_words: The domain of the nervous system is much more extensive
fleurons.rationale: Nervous-system turn: the ancillary verdict lands, before the lucidity-value critique (para 9).

p4c7.nb_note: start-anchored NB at para 10 ('NB. Precision of action is at odds...') — Sulphur bar + mono marker
p4c7.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated meniscus plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '16 FRAGMENTS · 1,009 WORDS', Fraunces 900 Bone drop cap.
p4c7.palette_role: Verdigris nearly annihilated; thin Sulphur meniscus (most withdrawn plate); NB bar Sulphur; fleuron Sulphur.
p4c7.title: Consciousness

p4c8.caption: Plate 8 · True, false, one stitch out
p4c8.content_rationale: The 49-fragment judgement triptych: Kant's prejudice (para 0), 'Knowledge is judgement!' (para 4), 'Judging is our most ancient faith' (para 22), the identical-case avowal (para 25), the body as guide (para 26), truth-as-inertia (para 33). The plate SPLITS the eye down the middle — true-half hatched, false-half stippled — a Sulphur seam with one stitch out of true. Three movements, three fleurons; split seams (paras 25/26) stay uncut.

fleurons.opening_words: ‘Knowledge is judgement!’ But judgement is a belief
fleurons.rationale: Seam fragment: the judgement/belief/knowledge knot stated, before the synthetic-judgements passage (para 5).

fleurons.opening_words: Judgement is the belief: ‘such-and-such is so’
fleurons.rationale: Identical-case hinge after the ancient-faith passage (para 22): the avowal of comparison, before the body-as-guide turn (para 26).
Descent into will-to-truth: the simple-as-imaginary verdict, before the truth-as-inertia passage (para 33).

p4c8.opener_composition: Standard opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated split plate (120px ≥900px, stacked above <900px), Fraunces title, Sulphur 2px rule + '49 FRAGMENTS · 2,190 WORDS', Fraunces 900 Bone drop cap.
p4c8.palette_role: Verdigris hatched/stippled halves; Sulphur seam + stray stitch; sub-note Verdigris tick; fleurons Sulphur.
p4c8.title: Judgement. True – False.

p4c9.caption: Plate 9 · The snapped arrow
p4c9.content_rationale: The anti-causalist sequence: space as substratum (para 0), cause-as-agent (para 5), atoms effecting nothing (para 13), causality-as-illusion (para 14), the In summa verdict (para 15), the (b) subject-fiction sub-note (para 20), the moral standpoint (para 24), will-to-truth (para 25). The plate snaps the CAUSE-ARROW: it enters the eye and exits bent 90°, a 'post hoc' tick-row below with one tick fallen out of line, the pupil a hollow ring (no agent). Split seams (paras 8/9, 26/27) stay uncut.

fleurons.opening_words: The interpretation of events in terms of causality is an illusion
fleurons.rationale: Causality-as-illusion hinge: the tree-as-word passage, before the In summa verdict (para 15).

fleurons.opening_words: The moral standpoint: the world is false
fleurons.rationale: Moral-standpoint hinge: morality-false-with-the-world, before the will-to-truth passage (para 25).

p4c9.palette_role: Verdigris eye + bent arrow; Sulphur arrowhead (match logic); sub-note Verdigris tick; fleurons Sulphur.
p4c9.title: Against Causalism

cohort_arc: Method → epistemology → ego → perspectivism → logic → consciousness → judgement → causality → appearance → metaphysics → value → science: demolition of the knower, then legislation of new values. The plates trace one Verdigris eye through thirteen wounds — sealed, mounted, inverted, cut sevenfold, cellularized, latticed, drowned, split, snapped, emptied, vaporized, nicked, prismed — and the eye ends as an instrument that knows it invents.
